QuestInfo.name: The Egg Result
QuestInfo.0: Yaku said he'd give up the egg. That just did not sit right with Alpha and Beta.
QuestInfo.1: Corba decided the egg would go to Yaku, who truly cared about the egg. Guess he was wise, after all! Alpha and Beta had to deliver the new to bIto#k and #bYaku#k
QuestInfo.2: Ito was so obsessed about the egg because he wanted to be an egg caretaker as well. Yaku overheard this and decided to teach Ito! It seemed like a never-ending conflict but it got solved very nicely. All hail Corba!

0.0: So! Ito wants egg so badly, he doesn't mind splitting it in two. But Yaku will give it up to save it. Easy solution! The egg goes to #rYaku#k! \r\n#L0##bBut Yaku said he'd give it up. #l\n#k
0.1: Yes! So it goes to #rYaku#k! He was more worried about egg than about himself. Only right to leave the egg in such a thoughtful, selfless Halflinger's hands. \r\n#L0##bOooh, I see what you did there. #l\n#k
0.2: Now tell #bIto#k and #bYaku#k that egg goes to Yaku. Tell Ito stay away from egg!

no.0: Aww, it'd be nice if you continue helping out...

npc.0: Ito mischievous sometimes, but he wouldn't purposely hurt the egg. No, no.
